verdict.rationale: Fin ships documented autonomy-oriented features—Fin Tasks, Procedures, Workflows, Proactive Outbound Suite, and webhook-driven triggers—that let it act on tickets/emails/chat without human intervention in the background (intercom-fin-docs-24, -26, -23, -15, -6). However, evidence is entirely first-party/docs-based with no independent hands-on confirmation that these automations reliably run unattended, and one HN commenter argues autonomous agent behavior is often unnecessary/overkill versus deterministic workflows, casting some doubt on real-world autonomy claims. Missing for 10: independent verification of background automation actually executing without oversight, and resolution of community skepticism about true autonomy vs scripted workflows.
